name: MRI Service Addons
author: Redoy Islam

sections.description:
MRI Service Addons is a powerful, lightweight, and fully customizable Elementor addon designed to showcase your services in style. It provides 4 unique and modern layout options to fit any design need.

Features

  • 4 Unique Layouts: Choose between Slider, Grid, List, and Sticky List styles.
  • Fully Customizable: Customize colors, typography, margins, paddings, backgrounds, and box shadows from the Elementor Style tab.
  • Dynamic Grid Controls: Easily set responsive column counts for Desktop, Tablet, and Mobile.
  • Slider Controls: Manage Autoplay, Speed, and Loop directly from Elementor.
  • Repeater Data: Add unlimited service items dynamically with custom icons, images, titles, descriptions, and links.
  • Developer Friendly: Clean code following strict WordPress.org coding standards.

Copyright

MRI Service Addons bundles the following third-party libraries:

  • Swiper – https://swiperjs.com/
    Copyright (c) 2014-2024 Vladimir Kharlampidi
    License: MIT (https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT)

  • Bootstrap (Grid & Utilities subset) – https://getbootstrap.com/
    Copyright (c) 2011-2024 The Bootstrap Authors
    License: MIT (https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT)
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/mri-service-addons directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Open any page with Elementor and search for the “MRI Services” widget.
  4. Drag and drop it to your page and customize it.
sections.faq:
Does it require Elementor?

Yes, this plugin is an addon for Elementor and requires the free version of Elementor to be installed and activated.

Can I use my own icons or images?

Yes, each service item in the repeater allows you to upload custom SVG icons, font icons, or standard images.
